'''Treetor''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] in the employ of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] as a hired thug. At some point, a businessman named [[Bennova]] gifted a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to Treetor. After Treetor and Jabba "split," Bennova hired some [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to retrieve the ship, believing that it was safe to do so since Treetor was no longer under Jabba's protection.<ref name="RPG2" />
